quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 40

questions.question: When you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm out, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and wait until you can go.
Honk and pass the bus on the left side.
Keep driving once you think the children have left the bus.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait until you can go.
questions.explanation: You must stop completely when a school bus has its stop arm out. Do not move until the bus pulls the stop arm in.

questions.question: On a two-lane road with traffic going both ways, you can only pass if:

options.text: You can see the road clearly ahead.
You can get back to your lane before meeting oncoming cars.
Your car is fast enough to pass safely.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Safe passing requires three things: you can see the road ahead clearly, you can return to your lane before meeting oncoming cars, and your car is fast enough to pass. Never pass where it is illegal or unsafe.

questions.question: A posted speed limit sign shows:

options.text: A suggested speed only.
The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The highest safe speed when road and weather are good.
The highest safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed when road and weather are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. In bad weather or poor road conditions, always slow down.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light means the same thing as:

options.text: A slow sign.
A yield sign.
A stop sign.
An intersection sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: When you see a flashing red light, you must stop. Let all other traffic that does not have to stop go first.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.

options.text: Flashing yellow
Steady green
Steady red
Flashing red

questions.correctAnswerText: Steady red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light tells you that a red light is coming next.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means:

options.text: Stop and look, then go if the way is clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to get through the intersection quickly.
Slow down and go carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and go carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and be careful as you drive through the intersection.

questions.question: When two cars arrive at an open intersection at the same time:

options.text: The driver on the right goes first.
The driver on the left goes first.
One driver can go without stopping.
One driver should honk to let the other go.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver on the right goes first.
questions.explanation: If a car on your right arrives at the intersection at the same time as you, let that car go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: Which statement is true about driving on wet roads?

options.text: The faster you drive, the less grip your tires have.
Good tires prevent water from affecting your car.
Deep water is safer than shallow water.
Slowing down makes the road more slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The faster you drive, the less grip your tires have.
questions.explanation: When you drive fast on wet roads, your tires cannot grip the road as well. If you go too fast, your tires may lose contact with the road and you will slide on water (hydroplane).

questions.question: A good defensive driver:

options.text: Always drives slowly.
Watches what other drivers do and expects problems.
Drives at the same speed all the time.
Only drives on roads they know well.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watches what other drivers do and expects problems.
questions.explanation: Good drivers stay alert to what other drivers are doing. They expect problems and try to avoid them before they happen.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: One-way road.
No right turn allowed.
Exit.
A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves sharply to the right ahead.

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle approaching from the right.
The vehicle approaching from the left.
The vehicle whose driver honks first.
The vehicle traveling the fastest.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle approaching from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection without traffic control devices, always yield to a vehicle coming from the right.

questions.question: Where is it best to keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only behind your vehicle.
Only on the left and right sides of your vehicle.
Only in front of your vehicle.
On all sides of your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: On all sides of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Keep space around all sides of your vehicle so you have time to react to hazards. Do not drive too close to vehicles on your left or right.

questions.question: When do you have the right-of-way to turn left?

options.text: At a solid green light.
At a flashing yellow light.
At a green arrow pointing left.
At a flashing red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: At a green arrow pointing left.
questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing left means you can turn left safely. Oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.question: How much lane width are motorcycles entitled to?

options.text: The bicycle lane.
The same full lane width as other vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.
The width of the sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to use the full lane width, just like all other vehicles.

questions.question: Which one must you obey before the others?

options.text: A steady red light.
A police officer.
A stop sign.
A flashing red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: A police officer.
questions.explanation: Follow directions from a police officer before signs, signals, or road markings. Police officers, fire police, work zone flag persons, and school crossing guards can direct traffic.

questions.question: When driving at night toward another vehicle, your headlights should be:

options.text: On high beam.
On low beam.
Off, using parking lights instead.
On high or low beam — either is fine.

questions.correctAnswerText: On low beam.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when approaching or following another vehicle at night. This keeps everyone safe.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other vehicles?

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with traffic flow and pass only when necessary.
Get to the front of slow traffic to see better.
Always flash lights and honk to alert other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic flow and pass only when necessary.
questions.explanation: Passing increases the chance of a collision. Drive at the same speed as surrounding traffic, follow the speed limit, and pass only when needed.

questions.question: If your tire blows out while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Slam on the brakes.
Hold the steering wheel tight and slow down gradually.
Keep driving normally.
Turn on emergency flashers and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel tight and slow down gradually.
questions.explanation: Do not brake immediately. Grip the wheel firmly to stay in your lane. Slow down by releasing the accelerator. When moving slowly, apply brakes lightly and pull off the road safely.

questions.question: When you are distracted while driving, what usually happens?

options.text: Nothing dangerous.
You react more slowly to hazards.
You drive faster.
It is only dangerous for young drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: You react more slowly to hazards.
questions.explanation: Distractions slow your reaction time to traffic and hazards. Distracted driving is never safe.

questions.question: You are waiting at a stop sign behind other vehicles. After they pass and there is no cross traffic, you:

options.text: May go through without stopping again.
Must stop again before proceeding.
May slowly roll past the stop sign.
May follow the vehicle ahead without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop again before proceeding.
questions.explanation: Always make a complete stop at the stop sign or stop line before proceeding. Check for approaching traffic. Do not skip this step even if other drivers pressure you.

questions.question: After stopping for a school bus unloading children, what should you do?

options.text: Wait for the children to wave at you before moving.
Watch for children walking on the side of the road.
Speed up quickly.
Turn on your emergency flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking on the side of the road.
questions.explanation: After stopping for a school bus with its stop arm out and lights flashing, watch for children walking on the side of the road. Always drive carefully around children.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Drive carefully through the intersection.
Prepare to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means go slowly and with caution. Look both ways for traffic before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?

options.text: A rectangular red sign.
A circular green sign.
A diamond-shaped yellow sign.
A triangular orange sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: A slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this sign travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Four-lane traffic ahead.
Divided highway ahead.
Two-way traffic ahead.
Intersection ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming in both directions ahead.

questions.question: Which statement about motorcycles is true?

options.text: Other drivers can follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle is more balanced with two riders than with one.
You must move completely into the left lane to pass a motorcycle.
Motorcycle brake lights turn on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must move completely into the left lane to pass a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are allowed to use a full lane of traffic. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: What can you do to prevent hydroplaning?

options.text: Make sure your tires have good tread.
Keep your tires inflated to the right pressure.
Slow down when it is raining.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, keep tires with good tread depth, inflate them to the correct pressure, and reduce speed in rain. Hydroplaning happens most often at higher speeds.

questions.question: When can you use flashing hazard lights?

options.text: When your vehicle is stopped or broken down on the highway or shoulder.
When rain makes it hard to see.
When driving at night.
In heavy traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When your vehicle is stopped or broken down on the highway or shoulder.
questions.explanation: Use flashing hazard lights only when your vehicle is stopped or broken down on the highway or shoulder. You can also use them in a funeral procession.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone.
Winding road.
Pedestrian crossing.
Low ground railroad crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low ground railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a low ground railroad crossing. At these crossings, railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may hit or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: It warns of hazards ahead or nearby.
It alerts you to school zones.
It alerts you to parks and recreation areas.
It alerts you to food and gas stations.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns of hazards ahead or nearby.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards that exist now or may happen. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic.
Multiple turns.
Lane shifting.
Do not block intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merging traffic.
questions.explanation: Warning signs get you ready for road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: If you have a tire blowout, what should you do?

options.text: Remove your foot from the gas.
Do not use your brakes right away.
Slow down gradually and pull to the side of the road.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: If you have a tire blowout, take your foot off the gas and do not brake immediately. Slow down gradually, then gently apply the brakes and pull to the side of the road.

questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and then:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for tailgating cars.
Move when the car ahead of you moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, look left first because traffic from the left is closer to you. Then look right, then left again to catch any traffic you may have missed.

questions.question: How should you enter a freeway?

options.text: Signal, let traffic go first, and enter at the same speed as other cars.
Signal and enter. Freeway traffic must let you in.
Drive slowly so you can watch the traffic.
Always stop completely first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, let traffic go first, and enter at the same speed as other cars.
questions.explanation: Signal and let other traffic go first when entering a freeway. Enter at the same speed as the traffic already on the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Do not pass.
Do not enter.
No turn on red.
Keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is coming ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. You must stay to the right.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Slow down and proceed carefully.
Continue through the intersection normally.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look both ways, and proceed with care.

questions.question: If you are stranded in a snowstorm, what should you do?

options.text: Leave your car and walk for help.
Lay down in your car and sleep.
Walk into the road to get other drivers' attention.
Stay in your car. You are more likely to be found there.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car. You are more likely to be found there.
questions.explanation: If you are stranded in a snowstorm, stay in your car and wait for help. You are more likely to be found if you stay with your vehicle. Walking in a snowstorm is unsafe.

questions.question: A driver has their left arm extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Start up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points downward, they are signaling that they are going to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this car.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.
Construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross in front of your car. What should you do?

options.text: Flash your lights.
Slow down.
Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian cross.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to stop when you see pedestrians on or crossing the road. Be extra careful around children. Always let pedestrians cross in crosswalks.

questions.question: If a crossing guard is directing traffic at a school, you must:

options.text: Follow the crossing guard's directions.
Do what other cars are doing, even if it goes against the guard's directions.
Assume the guard should not be directing traffic.
Follow normal rules as if no children were present.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the crossing guard's directions.
questions.explanation: Always follow directions from crossing guards and school zone signs. Slow down and use extra caution in school zones.

questions.question: You hear a siren behind you while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Stop where you are.
Pull over to the right and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.
Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights from an emergency vehicle behind you, pull over to the right side of the road and stop. This gives the emergency vehicle a clear path. If you are in heavy traffic, slow down and move over when you can.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches you on a one-way street. What must you do?

options.text: Drive with your flashers turned on.
Drive toward the nearest roadside and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down until the vehicle passes you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive toward the nearest roadside and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches on a one-way street, drive to the nearest side of the road and stop.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph needs how many feet to stop completely?

options.text: 50 feet
125 feet
400 feet
750 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 400 feet
questions.explanation: Large trucks need much longer to stop than cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph can take about 400 feet to stop completely.

questions.question: What is the best way to avoid crashes when driving on ice or snow?

options.text: Add extra weight to your vehicle for better grip.
Get off the highways as quickly as possible.
Use four-wheel drive.
Reduce your speed and increase your following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed and increase your following distance.
questions.explanation: Slow down and stay farther behind other vehicles when roads are snowy or icy. These are the best ways to avoid crashes in bad winter weather.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT affect how far it takes to stop your vehicle?

options.text: Steering ability
Braking distance
Reaction distance
Perception time

questions.correctAnswerText: Steering ability
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on how quickly you see a hazard, how quickly you react, and how well your brakes work. Steering ability does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks under 18,000 lbs. are allowed.
Hill ahead.
Truck stop ahead.
No trucks allowed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road narrows ahead.
There are curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves ahead with three or more turns.

questions.question: When can you carefully continue through an intersection with a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When pedestrians are crossing.
When you are turning right.
When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already inside the intersection when the light turns yellow, you may continue through carefully.

questions.question: What does this stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully; you do not always have to stop.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must make a complete stop. Yield to all vehicles and pedestrians. Once it is safe, you may go.

questions.question: What lights must you use when driving in rain?

options.text: Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
Parking lights.
No lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights when driving in the rain.
